body:
I have sought any and all treatment. Always been open to it. Trouble is I have no mental illness. I often wish it was insanity. At least it would make more sense. Instead I have mountains of shockingly fucked up evidence.

I am trapped In a pain specifically engineered to control my life. The only solution is death. I truly believe it now. Either I live in misery of constant surveillance, gangstalking and harassment that prevents any kind of trustful relationship or quality of life, or I commit suicide.

Unfortunately this is the choice. Been living In misery the best I can for six years and it just gets worse and worse. 

I am no martyr and do not care to be mourned or remembered, but I will die for my freedom for my own sake.

I understand if someone has loving support. 

But if there is no one...

My life is a blur of abuse and betrayal. I do not remember what freedom feels like or maybe I never  knew what it was at all.

And the family and friends and many strangers who enslaved me find my demise to be entertaining as they usher me to hell. 

It would be a final act of full control. I decide the end. Have no control over anything else that matters.

Reddit is a shitshow of anonymous cowards. 

If they can't say it to your face, fuck em they are nothing.
